name: Star-Cursed Lovers
source:
Star-Cursed Lovers is a fully voice-acted Dating Sim, in which you must use Dialogue Cards to woo your potential suitors!

Set forth as a Rizzler, Wizard, or Rebel, and try to free yourself from the curse which will fall upon you in 7 days!

[From [url=https://swiimii.itch.io/star-cursed-lovers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《星咒恋人》是一款全配音的约会模拟游戏，你必须使用对话卡来吸引潜在的追求者！

扮演Rizzler、巫师或叛逆者，尝试将自己从7天内降临到你身上的诅咒中解放出来！

[来自[url=https://swiimii.itch.io/star-cursed-lovers]itch.io[/url]]
